<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Lucky Donkey 6</title>
<style>
/* Lucky Donkey 6 by adamgiebl — https://uiverse.io/adamgiebl/lucky-donkey-6 */
button {
  color: #090909;
  padding: 0.7em 1.7em;
  font-size: 18px;
  border-radius: 0.5em;
  background: #e8e8e8;
  border: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
  transition: all .3s;
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 12px #c5c5c5,
             -6px -6px 12px #ffffff;
}

button:hover {
  border: 1px solid white;
}

button:active {
  box-shadow: 4px 4px 12px #c5c5c5,
             -4px -4px 12px #ffffff;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
